full_page.content:
1932, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. S.
Page 30 Cont. Apr. 8 Mrs. Victoria Beauroleil - 45 - kidney trouble - "incurable" .... I year sick - only one kidney 6 yrs.
Page 31 April David Dion Idaho - 5 children - cancer in mouth.
Tho's Manion (again) strepticotis .. blood (of Toronto Ca. )- May 10, 1932 Reported O.K. - Drs. astonished.
Dr. Roman - Stroke (?) ... that he be spared to family. Mrs ... sore eyes - & little boy also Thanks .... Wm. Carpenter Examination successful .... still Jennie Maceroni - 13 - paralysis in Herman Kiefer Mrs. Leontine Delof - 38 - of Washington D.C. leg amputated - great pain.
Mrs. Yaergans - not well - she & husband praying for blessing of family.
Mrs. Teresa Tracy - internal cancer - high-blood pressure. Mrs. July Foley - sinus - son not heard from 11 years. 1932, May Page 32 May 4 Mrs. Mary Murphy - 50 - Heart & Arteries trouble
John Laethem - 24 - refuses to make mission - 2 Sisters in Convent, etc.
Anna & Mary Binder - Mental
Mrs. V. Beausoleil - 45 - recovering from tubercular kidney - only one now for 6 yrs. Able to work again - youngest son to make First Communion May 15th
Robert Phillips - 24 - paralysed tumor on brain - had become in- diferant to mother's plea to practice religion.
Mrs. Lesprance - Ear trouble - anxious about Contract, etc. losing property.
